msg: Hello! I apologize for the lengthy advice, but it contains important information that will help you succeed in this game. The goal of the game is to collect as many mushrooms as possible. There is a pattern. Firstly, the gnomes will appear in a fixed pair of two: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple. The position, hat and size of the gnome are irrelevant.Each gnome within each pair will lead you to a different forest, one to a bright forest with a red basket and one to a dark forest with a yellow basket. Specifically, the orange, green, red and blue gnomes guide you to the bright forest while the brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes lead you to the dark forest.Note: You will have 1.5 seconds to choose the gnome and 1.5 seconds to collect the mushrooms. Be aware that the number of mushrooms in each forest constantly changes but use the information I provided above to assist you in discovering the potential pattern. Best of luck!
